title: Pokemon TCG Drampa (Friend Ball) Ascended Heroes 176/217 Reverse Holofoil Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokemon TCG card featuring Drampa (Friend Ball) from the ME: Ascended Heroes set. The card is an Uncommon rarity, with English language text and illustrated by Scav. This standard-sized card is made of card stock and has a Colorless type with a reverse Holofoil finish. It is part of the 176/217 series and manufactured by The Pokemon Company in the United States. With its unique design and rarity, this card appeals to collectors and players of the Pokemon TCG game.
